summary: Leiden University's Excellence Scholarship takes €10,000, €15,000, €17,500, €18,500 or €19,000 off the tuition fee for top students with a non-EEA, non-EFTA passport on a master's starting in September. Leiden says plainly that it is not a full scholarship.
meta_title: Leiden Excellence Scholarship (LExS): €10,000 to €19,000 off tuition
meta_description: Leiden's LExS takes €10,000 to €19,000 off a master's tuition fee for top non-EEA students. Apply by 1 December 2026 for a September start.
covers: A share of the tuition fee: €10,000, €15,000, €17,500, €18,500 or €19,000. The level is final.
It does not cover the full cost of your studies.
eligibility: Applicants to a full-time Leiden master's starting in September, excluding the non-advanced LLM and MSc programmes at Leiden Law School.
A non-EEA, non-EFTA passport, and no right to Dutch government student finance. All LLM Advanced Studies programmes and the MSc International Relations and Diplomacy have no nationality limit.
An indication that you are among the top 10% of graduates of a relevant programme; proof of ranking is not required.
It cannot be combined with another full scholarship from an external provider.
how_to_apply: Apply online for admission and pay any application fee, allowing up to 3 working days.
In the Scholarships section of your application, say you want the LExS and upload a PDF motivation letter of no more than 500 words.
Submit by 1 December 2026. If you apply to several programmes, make a separate LExS application in each.
Leiden tells applicants by email before the end of March.
watch_out: Late applications are not considered, and you cannot change your application after submitting.
You pay whatever the award leaves of the fee, plus your living costs.
costs: The award covers €10,000 to €19,000; you pay the rest
documents: Your Leiden admission application and any application fee.
A PDF motivation letter of no more than 500 words.

faq.q: Does the Leiden Excellence Scholarship cover all my costs?
faq.a: No. Leiden says the LExS is not a full scholarship. It takes €10,000 to €19,000 off the tuition fee.
1 December 2026, for master's programmes starting in September. Late applications are not considered.
